THREE MEASURED SIGNATURES, none assumed: (a) no `NG: PS` column in MISO's extract; (b) `NG: WAT` peaks 3,535 / 3,964 MW (2023 / 2024) against a 2,478.4 MW conventional-`HY` EIA-860 nameplate -- 580 / 826 h/yr ABOVE IT, physically impossible for inflow hydro -- beside a 2,416.8 MW PS fleet (Ludington 1,978.8, Taum Sauk 408, Degray 30); (c) ZERO negative-`WAT` hours in any year 2018-2025, so pumping is not netted and the contamination is one-way gross discharge, while EIA-923 `PS` net generation is NEGATIVE every year (-0.840 / -1.033 TWh, the round-trip loss) -- the opposite sign, independently confirming the series is gross discharge.
